description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget 'HomeScreen' that serves as the main interface for a notes application. It includes UI components such as AppBar, Drawer, ListView of notes, and FloatingActionButton, and interacts with state controllers for authentication and notes management. It provides functionalities like viewing, searching, filtering by tags, editing, creating, and deleting notes.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays a list of notes with functionalities to view, search, filter, and create new notes.

methods.name: _subtitle
methods.description: Generates a subtitle preview of a note's body, handling empty and long content appropriately.
